essence.zh: 居中标题 + 一行横向导航 + 极少量徽章 + 水平线分节；不靠图，靠排版和链接密度。
essence.en: Centered title, one inline nav row, very few badges, horizontal rules between sections; no images, typography and link density carry it.

tone.zh: 手册口吻：陈述句、短、克制，不推销。
tone.en: Manual voice: declarative, short, restrained, never selling.

notes.zh: 适合成熟工具 / 框架：不靠视觉，靠结构和文风；很适合已有大量文档的仓库。
notes.en: For mature tools and frameworks: structure and voice instead of visuals; ideal when documentation already exists.
